hero.title: Shipping Information
hero.subtitle: Fast, reliable delivery across Ghana and beyond

policies.title: Free Standard Shipping
content: Free standard shipping on all orders over GHS 500
Orders under GHS 500: Regional delivery fee applies

policies.title: Express Delivery
content: Available in major cities (Accra, Kumasi, Takoradi)
GHS 50 flat rate for express delivery

policies.title: International Shipping
content: Ships to West Africa (Nigeria, Ivory Coast, Togo, Benin)
Rates calculated at checkout based on destination
Customs duties and taxes are the recipient's responsibility

timeline.description: Your order is confirmed and sent to our warehouse

restrictions: PO Box addresses not accepted for express delivery
Some remote areas may have extended delivery times
Signature required for orders over GHS 1000

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking number. You can also track it in your account under 'My Orders' or use our Track Order page.

faqs.question: What if I'm not home when my package arrives?
faqs.answer: Our courier will attempt delivery twice. After the second attempt, the package will be held at the nearest pickup point for 5 business days. You'll receive SMS notifications with pickup details.

faqs.question: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
faqs.answer: If your order hasn't been dispatched yet, contact us immediately at support@ssfashion.com or call +233 24 123 4567. Once dispatched, address changes may not be possible.

faqs.question: Do you offer weekend delivery?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery operates Monday-Saturday. Express delivery in Accra is available on Saturdays for orders placed before 12 PM Friday. No Sunday delivery.

faqs.question: What are the Northern Ghana regions?
faqs.answer: Northern Ghana includes: Northern, North East, Savannah, Upper East, and Upper West regions. These regions have a reduced delivery fee of GHS 20.
